print("Gap check (two copies of v must be v+1 apart):")
all_ok = True

    positions = [i for i, x in enumerate(seq) if x == v]
    gap = positions[1] - positions[0]
    expected = v + 1
    ok = gap == expected
    if not ok:
        all_ok = False
    print(f"  v={v}: positions {positions[0]} and {positions[1]}, gap={gap}, expected={expected} {'✓' if ok else '✗'}")
print(f"\nAll constraints satisfied: {all_ok}")
